zh.heroBadge: ABOUT QUANTBASE · 用 AI 學量化
zh.heroTitle: 一個人，一個用 AI 打破量化門檻嘅念頭。
zh.heroDesc: QuantBase 是一個由個人開發者建立的 AI 量化學習平台。我哋相信，量化交易唔應該只屬於華爾街嘅專業團隊——透過 AI 同自動化，任何人都可以用數據同策略去投資。
zh.whyParagraph1: 傳統量化交易門檻極高：要識寫程式、要理解金融模型、要買昂貴嘅數據源。好多有心學投資嘅人，連第一步都踏唔出去。我哋發現，AI 可以大幅降低呢個門檻——自然語言就可以描述策略，機器學習可以自動最佳化參數。
zh.whyParagraph2: QuantBase 就係為咗呢個願景而生：一個畀普通人用 AI 學量化、寫策略、回測同執行嘅平台。唔需要 PhD，唔需要十年經驗，只需要一個好奇嘅心同學習嘅熱情。
zh.quote:
AI 唔係取代你，
係放大你嘅決策能力。
zh.contactTitle:
有問題、建議，
或者想交流量化策略？
zh.contactDesc: 我哋好歡迎任何意見。無論你係初學者定老手，每一個交流都可能係新策略嘅起點。
zh.footerTitle: 感謝每一位願意學習嘅你。
zh.footerDesc: 有你哋嘅支持，我哋先可以繼續完善 QuantBase，幫更多人用 AI 做好投資決策。
zh.footerSlogan: 用 AI 學量化，從此唔使再靠運氣炒股。

en.heroBadge: ABOUT QUANTBASE · Learn Quant with AI
en.heroTitle: One person, one idea to democratize quantitative trading with AI.
en.heroDesc: QuantBase is an AI-powered quantitative learning platform built by an indie developer. We believe quant trading shouldn't be exclusive to Wall Street — with AI and automation, anyone can invest using data-driven strategies.
en.whyParagraph1: Traditional quant trading has high barriers: you need coding skills, financial modeling knowledge, and expensive data feeds. Many aspiring investors never take the first step. We realized AI can dramatically lower these barriers — describe a strategy in plain English, and machine learning optimizes parameters automatically.
en.whyParagraph2: QuantBase was born from this vision: a platform where ordinary people can learn quant, write strategies, backtest, and execute — all with the help of AI. No PhD required, no decade of experience needed — just curiosity and passion to learn.
en.quote:
AI doesn't replace you,
it amplifies your decision-making.
en.contactTitle:
Questions, ideas,
or want to discuss quant strategies?
en.contactDesc: We welcome any feedback. Whether you're a beginner or a pro, every conversation could spark the next great strategy.
en.footerTitle: Thank you to everyone willing to learn.
en.footerDesc: With your support, we can keep improving QuantBase and help more people make better investment decisions with AI.
en.footerSlogan: Learn quant with AI — no more gambling on stocks.
